text.spent_note: FY2026 spent is the district’s own actual column for the closed year; it does not say whether bills still owed at year end are in it. Spent − budget compares FY2026 with itself. Version 1 against what was spent is in dollars only: a percent from spending to a budget mixes two kinds of figure, and the two are two years apart. Each line is net of grants and fees, not its whole cost.
text.spent_summary: Of 229 lines that spent money in FY2026, Version 1 budgets 50 below what they spent, by $1,110,118 together, and 175 above it, by $4,902,962.
